rows.TEXT: A veteran in the struggle to reclaim Elven glory, nobody enters the forest without his knowledge.

Serphis 
"Our troops are assembled and awaiting your orders, my lady. We have supplied them with potions and scrolls."

Fyrwenn 
"Good, thank you Serphis. We will keep them out of view while we send in our negotiator. If we can reason with the Humans, there may still be a chance to get through this without further bloodshed."

Fyrwenn 
"Serphis, I would like you to aid Tora'ach and I with tactical maneuvers, if you have no opposition?"

Serphis 
"He set out to place his troops in covert locations, as you have asked."

Fyrwenn 
"What?? I never asked for such a thing.but it is too late for explanations."
Bring a group to meet with the Empire's forces.
"Before we shed blood, please sheath your steel for but a moment, we only wish to speak..."

Bordabas 
"Speak from where you stand, messenger; if you come to seek forgiveness, you will not find it here!"

Fyrwenn 
"Forgiveness...no...we cannot expect that. The rash behavior of some of my people has brought us to the brink of war. However, I am sure we would both prefer to resolve this without adding to our losses..."

Fyrwenn 
"It is for you to decide...what must be done to repair the wounds between our people? We will try to make amends."

Borbadas 
"Hmm...to be honest, this is unexpected. I am a soldier; I do not deal in treaties. However, I am eager to return these men to their families. We will need some time to evaluate you proposal."

Atlasien 
"Personally, I'll be content when we receive two of their heads for each warrior they have cost us thus far!"

Borbadas 
"Atlasien, you are out of line! As a sign of good will, leave these lands. Take your troops back to your grove while we deliver your message to Emry."

Tora'ach 
"I've had about enough of this arrogant yapping! No Elves will follow any order of yours; the only message your pathetic king will receive will be the one carved into your carcasses! Now, brothers! SUMMON FORTH TAIRENN GULL!"

Tora'ach 
"The dragon...control it!!! What are you doing?!!"

Fyrwenn 
"Serphis! The Empire will no longer listen to our pleas and that dragon will soon destroy us all! Quickly, send out our forces! We must deal with them before any reinforcements arrive. I shall deal with Tora'ach..."

Objective: Destroy Tairenn Gull. 
 
Objective: Destroy all Empire Generals before reinforcements arrive.

Fyrwenn 
"Have you gone completely mad Tora'ach?! You cannot control that beast! What in Gallean's name are you doing!?! Answer me!!!"

Fyrwenn 
"Ridiculous! Now we've made enemies of the Empire and we must deal with this as well?! No doubt reinforcements are headed this way! If we survive this, I will escort you to Hearth's Grove to see you answer for everything you have done!"
"We have slain the last of this group, but we should prepare for a counter strike from the Empire soon."

Serphis 
"Fall back to the capital and heal yourselves before moving on. This might buy us time to scout the enemy forces before battle."

Fyrwenn 
"Serphis! Retreat your troops! The Empire reinforcements are upon us and we still have not dealt with the current army in this area. We must fall back to Hearth's Grove to defend it from invasion!"
"Sir, we have killed one of the generals in an Empire camp! From the information we found on him, there seems to be a total of two camps in this area and one Human city."

Serphis 
 
"Then we must defeat all generals before the reinforcements arrive, we can use their own city for our defense!"
"The general from the second Empire camp has fallen!"

Serphis 
"Good...this will fortify our presence in the area."
"My lord, it appears we have broken the Empire army's morale with the death of their generals! Their troops are fleeing like cowards!"

Serphis 
"Excellent, regroup at the Capital! We shall prepare a garrison for the city to deal with Human reinforcements."

Fyrwenn 
"Serphis, I am heading back to Hearth's Grove in order to discuss today's events with the council, especially Tora'ach's behavior! I am appointing you commander of the Thelenan army until my return."

Fyrwenn 
"Tora'ach's bunch will not follow you, so I have selected one of theirs as your liaison. I have assigned Geintel to watch over the wild Elves. There is much work to be done still. We must assure a firm grasp on this area."

Serphis 
"I shall do all in my power to make this land fit for our people!"
